description: This is a Java source file defining a Fragment class named SwipeRefreshLayoutBasicFragment for an Android application. The class demonstrates how to implement a swipe-to-refresh pattern using SwipeRefreshLayout with a ListView that updates its content asynchronously when the user performs a swipe gesture or selects a menu item.

classes.name: SwipeRefreshLayoutBasicFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment showcasing swipe-to-refresh functionality with a ListView, including refresh logic triggered by gestures or menu actions, with simulated background data loading.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, retrieves UI components, sets color scheme for swipe refresh.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up ListView and its adapter, attaches refresh listener.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections; triggers refresh when refresh menu item is selected.

methods.name: initiateRefresh
methods.description: Starts the background task to refresh data.

methods.name: onRefreshComplete
methods.description: Updates ListView data and stops the refresh animation after background task completion.

methods.name: DummyBackgroundTask
methods.description: Simulates a background data fetch with a delay, then updates UI with new data.
